title: Frontend Component Tree
purpose: Full component hierarchy from root <App> through providers, role-based layouts, UI primitives, shared domain components, auth guards, and all feature modules for fans, creators, and admins.
audience: Frontend developers, new team members, architects
description: The React component tree shows all 40+ components organized into layers: root App with ToastProvider + BrowserRouter + AuthProvider, layout components (MainLayout, Header, Sidebar, Footer), UI primitives (Button, Input, Card, Modal, AudioPlayer), shared domain components (ContentCard, ContentLockOverlay, TipModal, UnlockModal, etc.), auth guards (withAuthGuard, ProtectedRoute, CreatorRouteGuard), fan features (FanFeed, FanGallery, FanSubscriptions, FanMessages), creator features (CreatorDashboard, CreatorContent, CreatorAnalytics, CreatorEarnings, CreatorMessages, BulkUploadPage, WalletSettings), admin features (AdminPanel with 8 sub-panels), and shared MessageBubble. The tree reveals that fan routes under /fan/* lack withAuthGuard protection, exposing UI to unauthenticated users.

connections.label: App renders MainLayout for authenticated routes
App applies withAuthGuard HOC to protected routes
App applies ProtectedRoute for admin routes
App applies CreatorRouteGuard for creator routes
Sidebar shows ImpersonationBanner when admin is impersonating
ContentCard shows ContentLockOverlay for locked content
ContentCard opens TipModal on tip action
ContentCard opens UnlockModal on unlock action

ContentLockManager provides unlock status to ContentViewerModal

CreatorMessages renders MessageBubble for each message

errorPaths.recovery: User refreshes page to retry chunk load

validationRules: Fan routes (/fan/*) lack withAuthGuard — any authenticated user can access fan UI regardless of role
Creator routes (/hub/*) are guarded by CreatorRouteGuard requiring creator role + onboarding + verification
Admin routes (/admin/*) are guarded by ProtectedRoute requiring admin role
Public routes (/, /enclave, /creator/:username, /content/:contentId) have no auth requirements
businessRules: Route structure enforces role-based access: public < auth < fan < creator < admin
ImpersonationBanner only shows when X-Impersonating-User-Id header is active
VerificationBanner only shows for creators whose verification is pending
securityConsiderations: Fan routes lack withAuthGuard — unauthenticated users can access /fan/* UI (UI leak, gap H-05)
Admin impersonation shows ImpersonationBanner but has no audit trail of impersonation actions
Lazy loading reduces initial bundle size but does not enforce access control
performanceConsiderations: 14 of 34 routes are lazy-loaded via React.lazy() + Suspense for code splitting
ContentLockManager centralizes lock state to avoid redundant API calls across components
Recharts used in CreatorAnalytics may impact render performance with large datasets
annotations: No fan route guard: /fan/* routes lack withAuthGuard (security gap)
No React ErrorBoundary exists at the App level — uncaught errors crash UI (J-01 gap)
ImpersonationBanner provides visual indicator but no audit trail (security gap)
